title: Walking and Stamina
body:
Syntax: north | south | east | west | northeast | northwest | southeast | southwest | up | down

Description: Each successful walk to another room consumes 1 or 2 Stamina. Blocked exits and closed doors cost nothing. You can still walk when exhausted; Stamina never drops below zero. Automatic Track movement also uses walking Stamina.

Date: 2026-09-27
